description:
Minimal, Docker-free Quarkus app that adds quarkus-smallrye-health on top of the bootui-quarkus
        extension and proves the Health panel light-up: a custom MicroProfile @Liveness HealthCheck is read in
        process via SmallRyeHealthReporter, mapped by QuarkusHealthProvider onto the neutral HealthNodeDto, and
        surfaced on GET /bootui/api/health by the shared engine HealthService. Kept separate from
        bootui-quarkus-integration-tests (which deliberately has NO SmallRye Health) so the SmallRye-absent
        setup-guidance path and the SmallRye-present capture path are each proven in isolation — the same split
        used for the OpenTelemetry-present/absent telemetry coverage.
